notes.title: Project's news!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Sorry for the lack of news for so long, I wasn't sure if I should write this information on Steam... 

I am still working on the the updates, but unfortunately, the work is progressing very slowly. This year I was diagnosed with multiple sclerosis, I had an exacerbation during which my left eye began to see worse, I was in the hospital, took a long time to recover from the IVs and couldn't accept my new condition.

Now I am fine, but I still suffer from side effects from the therapy and constant fatigue. I don't always have the strength to work on the project after my job, but I am not going to give it up and want to finish it.

I can't say exactly when I will be able to finish the game, it may take years, but I don't want to part with my beloved characters and universe <3.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42398544/837b1a6baff09b56e2ca3df85e698e9b7bbe4913.png[/img]

notes.title: Project news - April
notes.notes:
Hello! 

I'm not a great at writing long reports, so I'll keep it short. 

I'm still working on the new update, which will continue the Greed Arc and finally allow us to get into the mysterious Pyramid Bank. 

At the same time, I'm working on improving the combat system and adding combat not only in the Freezer, but also at the beginning of the game in Subway and beyond. 

Also, our animator has finished working on an updated version of Kali, which means that once the CG artwork is updated, Kali will look different :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42398544/850dc2969fa65e4df78d67b5fc0543e32977979d.gif[/img]

notes.title: First Release and First BugFix!
notes.notes:
Hello from Pandemonium!

I am excited to announce that I have finally released my first game on Steam. I hope you will enjoy it, even though it's still in Early Access and requires a lot of work and polishing.

I have already received a lot of useful feedback from players, and I have just released the first bugfix. Additionally, I have improved the Russian localization, and the voice-over lines should now be in their correct places.

Thank you for your support, and I look forward to hearing your thoughts on the game!
